records.text: Vantage Systems is a week in with no project yet, worth a nudge at this point

records.subject: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

It's been a few days -- how's the setup going on your end? If you'd like a short walkthrough call, I'm happy to set one up.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Vantage Systems!
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no project, no invite, no key milestone despite a welcome email (email:05cf935b), a held onboarding call (calendar:ca8f7e0f) and a check-in (email:cb8bcfb7) with zero customer reply or tickets. Engaged enough to attend a call, so not negligible, but silence after it signals low unaided momentum.

draft.subject: Getting your first project set up in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the onboarding call last week. Since then I haven't wanted to leave you stuck at the first step, so here's the short version: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'll stay on while you create that first project and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
